description: Cheminements piétons dans Paris d'après OpenstreetMap is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Jungle Bus. This dataset describes the pedestrian paths in Paris intramural: it includes sidewalks, pedestrian crossings, pedestrian streets, pedestrian squares, etc. There are also parking spaces reserved for wheelchair users, as well as some entrances to shops and metro stops. The data are entirely from OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Jungle Bus. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian paths in Paris according to OpenstreetMap" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Jungle Bus. Its keywords include cheminements-accessibles, pietons, accessibilite, cheminement-pieton, openstreetmap, cheminement. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
